derived_from: C29 unchanged prompts and round29_edit_diagnosis test2; separate from C30 paragraph test.
planned_scope: Two conditions, two independent repeats: four continuation passages, eight sequential author requests, zero fresh sessions. Preserve all first drafts and revisions.
change: Only textual exposure to the three earlier unreleased fiction drafts differs. All prompts and full rich backgrounds stay exact C29. Reset author status held equal.
loop: Each reset whole-story author reads complete Covenant/persona, superseded-proposal block, published B00-02 and B03 submission. It generates one draft, then receives the unchanged C29 editorial task in the same conversation. Both conditions retain their current draft during revision.
context_layout: The superseded-proposals header and empty block occur in both conditions before published conversation. Only the exposed condition contains the three exact old drafts, labeled by source turn. No source B03 draft or later publication is supplied.
instruction_delivery: Both stages explicitly delegate frozen task files. Same wrapper and role placement across conditions; different from C29 direct common-rule delivery.
limitations: Small matched context screen. Not a recreation of old agent private state or full tool conversation; not a causal test of persistence itself, production API behavior, latency, or cost. No long-session selection claim.
